Free transport with NT to Kunsten

If you purchase your admission ticket online in 2026, you will automatically receive a free transport ticket. If you are an annual pass holder, you can obtain a free ticket by downloading a discount code here on the website.

Curious about the architecture?

The museum building on Kong Chr. Allé in Aalborg was completed in 1972. It was designed by the world-famous Finnish architect Alvar Aalto, as well as Elissa Aalto and Jean-Jacques Baruël, and it is the only museum building outside of Finland that Aalto has designed.
